caption: The drawing depicts a single brown spur with a leather strap. The leather strap is dark brown with a rounded, button-like piece on the left end and a metal buckle at the top. The spur itself is a metallic brown color, decorated with circular metal accents in silver or gray, and a central star insignia. The rowel (the spiked wheel at the end of the spur) is also metallic brown and has multiple pointed spokes. The spur is rendered against a plain, off-white background with minimal shading or shadow, and there are faint pencil marks framing the drawing as well as the artist’s name, “Ellen Allen,” visible in the lower right corner, and the words “Actual Size” lightly written in the lower left corner.
title: Spur
